label: D2 rare a2->S1 transition after a rewarded a2 trial, late in the episode (trial >= 80)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S1 by a rare transition (a2/S1 input). It is also gated by: previous trial rewarded (in_rew 0 at D2 but prev_reward 1), previous choice a2 (a repeat, i.e. stay; almost never after an a1 trial), and the late episode (no activations before trial ~78; all mass at trials 80-99). Usually S2 is the good state (86% of mass), so this is a surprising rare move away from the good state. Among these steps, activation goes with low model value (value < 5.2 holds 90% of mass), which is added to the predicate. Dev scores: D2 & a2 & S1 gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.06; adding trial >= 80 and prev_reward 1 gives F1 0.60; adding prev_action != 1 gives 0.62; adding value < 5.5 gives F1 0.72 (P 0.59, R 0.92, mass recall 0.98). All variables are observed at D2 (action and state are known by then). Never fires at D1/GO, on S2 arrivals, on a1 choices, or before late trials. About 40% of predicate-true steps stay inactive, and no observed variable we tested separates them, so the explanation is incomplete.
